snippet.title: The Ember Guardian - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Light is your last hope. Defend your fire against relentless waves of creatures lurking in the darkness. Manage your resources, upgrade your base, and command your emberlings to survive each night. 

🎮 Add the game to your Steam Wishlist ! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570060/The_Ember_Guardian/

The Ember Guardian will be available on Steam in Q4 2025. A Demo version will be available during Steam's Next Fest in June 🔥
